_: ADR-113 T3: every side door scripts/side-door-sweep.mjs finds, with its reason and what governs it. A site not here fails the gate, and so does an entry no site matches. `doors` is the class as mapped on 2026-10-19; since ADR-117 T3 each is caught, or a boundary with where it closes, and an open one fails the gate.

writer.plugin/scripts/check-record.mjs: the one writer of checks.jsonl, fast-checks.jsonl and baseline.jsonl, called by qh-check alone (ADR-101, ADR-081, ADR-111)
writer.plugin/bin/adr-verify: the one writer of a task's Verification Log and Mutation Log (CLAUDE.md §4)
writer.plugin/bin/adr-lint: names the Mutation Log in its advice; what it writes is its own cache, by write_text and replace (ADR-113)
writer.plugin/scripts/completion-rules.mjs: names the Verification Log in a turn-end sentence; what it writes is claims.jsonl (ADR-113)
writer.plugin/lib/record.py: write_receipts, the one writer of receipts.jsonl, called by adr-verify's append_entry alone (ADR-117 T2)
writer.core/hooks/prose_test.go: a Go test that writes a fixture checks.jsonl into its own temporary repository's state directory (ADR-120 T9); it is never built into qh and never reaches a user's ledger

spawn.plugin/scripts/qh-check.mjs commit: qh-check --commit commits only on its own check's pass, and refuses a tree unlike the index (ADR-100)

tool.PostToolUse facts-gate-dispatch.sh mcp__: open at the write: the per-edit gates read tool_input.file_path, which an mrw plan does not carry; the turn-end artifact pass gates every path the plan named (ADR-113 T2)
tool.PostToolUse post-edit-check.sh mcp__mrw_: open at the write: the per-edit gates read tool_input.file_path, which an mrw plan does not carry; the turn-end artifact pass gates every path the plan named (ADR-113 T2)
tool.PostToolUse facts-gate-dispatch.sh Bash: a shell command's writes are not named paths; the turn end observes the tree it left (ADR-060)
tool.PostToolUse facts-gate-dispatch.sh Power: a shell command's writes are not named paths; the turn end observes the tree it left (ADR-060)
tool.PostToolUse post-edit-check.sh Bash: a shell command's writes are not named paths; the turn end observes the tree it left (ADR-060)
tool.PostToolUse post-edit-check.sh PowerShel: a shell command's writes are not named paths; the turn end observes the tree it left (ADR-060)

tool.PostToolUse lifecycle.mjs PowerShell: a shell command's writes are not named paths; PreToolUse reads its command and the turn end observes the tree it left (ADR-060, ADR-061)

doors.why: a write into the state directory the hook can see (an Edit, Write or mrw write, a redirection or tee) is refused (ADR-117 T1)

doors.where: CI, and the forge's required checks once main has them: the pushed tree's suite is run again there, and a forged local row stands in for nothing
doors.why: a program that writes checks.jsonl itself, or a shell form the guard does not read (a target built from a variable, a string a command builds and runs, the forms in BACKLOG §387), is not a command the hook can read; a local gate cannot tell a run from a transcription (ADR-005, ADR-117)
refused by git's own hook where it is armed (ADR-066); said as R2 at the turn end otherwise (ADR-060)
commit-tree with update-ref, merge, cherry-pick and revert make commits R2 names at the turn end; advice, not a refusal (ADR-060)

doors.where: the forge: ruleset 25462988 on main requires the selftest checks with no bypass (ADR-118 T2), which release-evidence and land --dry-run read back
doors.why: --no-verify skips git's pre-push hook, and the text refusal reads only the command the hook is shown (ADR-061, ADR-066, ADR-117 T3); a sha whose checks have not passed is rejected by the forge (GH013), whoever pushes it

doors.where: review: a change to .github/workflows is a behaviour change, reviewed before the tag (CLAUDE.md §12)
doors.why: the forge counts skipped and neutral as passing a required check and runs the workflow the pushed sha carries, so a sha whose workflow skips a required job passes the ruleset; land stops on anything but success (ADR-118)
qh-check --commit refuses an index unlike the working tree (ADR-100)

an uncommitted Verification or Mutation Log row no adr-verify receipt names is refused by adr-lint, and the receipts file is in the guarded state directory (ADR-117 T2); a row committed by hand is in the commit its reviewer reads (ADR-088)
deleting receipts.jsonl, an rm the guard does not read, leaves every uncommitted row unreceipted and so refused: it fails closed (ADR-117 T2)
the reviewer guard and the write record see it (ADR-113 T2); the per-edit gates see it at the turn end
a fast pass counts only for the fastCheck the project declares now (ADR-113 T3)
